name: Altraud Randrody
original_name: アルトロッド・ランドローディ
source:
Heir to the throne despite being the second prince of the White Kingdom. Lively and free-spirited, good at spoiling. He acts before he can even think.

When he was a child, he followed his older brother and always wanted to be like him. He's good at martial arts, but he doesn't really like studying.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moonparrot.com/html/game/soukoku/chara.html]official website[/url]]
